test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

DISMAL
solution:
The correct answer is "**gloomy**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's take a look at the following words:

 
 
• **Dismal** means causing sadness, or showing a lack of hope or positivity.

 
 
• For **example**, "The news of the pandemic's latest surge had a **dismal** effect on the stock market."
 
 
 
• **Cheerful** means happy and optimistic, conveying a sense of joy and positivity.
 
 
• For **example**, "Her **cheerful** demeanor brought a smile to everyone's face."
 
 
 
• **Encouraging** means giving someone hope, support or confidence.
 
 
• For **example**, "His words of **encouragement** helped her overcome her fear of public speaking."
 
 
 
• **Gloomy** means dark or dim, or causing feelings of sadness or depression.
 
 
• For **example**, "The weather was **gloomy** and rainy, matching her mood."
 
 
 
• **Bright** means full of light or shining, or giving a sense of hope and positivity.
 
 
• For **example**, "The **bright** sunshine on the first day of summer lifted everyone's spirits."
 
 
 
 
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** for "**dismal**" is "**gloomy**."

Thus, ***option 3*** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• Dismal का अर्थ है उदासी पैदा करना, या आशा या सकारात्मकता की कमी दिखाना।
 
• Cheerful का अर्थ है खुश और आशावादी, खुशी और सकारात्मकता की भावना व्यक्त करना।
 
• Encouraging करने का अर्थ है किसी को आशा, समर्थन या विश्वास देना।
 
• Gloomy का अर्थ है अंधेरा या मंद, या उदासी या अवसाद की भावना पैदा करना।
 
• Bright का अर्थ है प्रकाश या चमक से भरा हुआ, या आशा और सकारात्मकता की भावना देना।
